keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Charlton Athletic 1, Sheffield United 0. Millenic Alli (Charlton Athletic) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Dan McNamara.
Goal! Charlton Athletic 1, Sheffield United 1. Jordan Ayew (Sheffield United) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a set piece situation.
Dan McNamara (Charlton Athletic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Hamza Choudhury (Sheffield United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Tyler Bindon (Charlton Athletic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Alan Mwamba (Charlton Athletic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Femi Seriki replaces Hamza Choudhury.
Second Half begins Charlton Athletic 1, Sheffield United 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Femi Seriki (Sheffield United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Mark McGuinness replaces Femi Seriki because of an injury.
Joe Rankin-Costello (Charlton Athletic) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Sonny Carey replaces Joe Rankin-Costello.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Harvey Knibbs replaces Alan Mwamba.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Thomas Cannon replaces Jordan Ayew.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Matty Godden replaces Charlie Kelman.

Goal! Charlton Athletic 2, Sheffield United 1. Matty Godden (Charlton Athletic) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Millenic Alli with a cross.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Oliver Arblaster replaces Ben Brereton.
Substitution, Sheffield United. Tyrese Campbell replaces Kalvin Phillips.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Oliver Skipp replaces Tyreece Campbell.
Second Half ends, Charlton Athletic 2, Sheffield United 1.
